description: This file declares the 'Surfaces' class which manages multiple Wayland surface objects, including setting callbacks for frame updates and display events, handling surface creation/destruction, and processing surface frames. It is part of the Wayland server implementation in the Android Open Source Project.
external_methods: std::function<void(std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t, std::uint8_t*)>

classes.name: Surfaces
classes.description: Manages multiple Wayland surface objects, providing callback mechanisms for frame updates and display events, and handling surface lifecycle events.

methods.name: SetFrameCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when a new frame is available for any surface.

methods.name: SetDisplayEventCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked for display-related events.

methods.name: SetFramesAreRGBA
methods.description: Sets whether the frames should be reported as RGBA regardless of the reported format.

methods.name: HandleSurfaceFrame
methods.description: Internal method to handle incoming surface frame data.

methods.name: HandleSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Internal method to handle creation of a new surface.

methods.name: HandleSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Internal method to handle destruction of a surface.
